title: Planning and Installing Recessed Lighting: Conventional Housing vs. Wafer LED in a Kitchen
summary: This This Old House segment documents an electrician guiding a homeowner and builder through kitchen lighting planning after framing. The discussion weighs traditional recessed housings against modern low-profile wafer-style LEDs, highlighting how cabinet placement, ceiling framing, and clearance influence fixture placement, light distribution, and installation. The dialogue covers driver configurations, mounting options, and practical layout decisions around cabinets, the fridge, and the sink, emphasizing flexibility around joists and insulation while illustrating post-drywall installation steps and how to avoid conflicts with existing framing.
